unit.why: An anecdote: a woman comes to the Maggid (of Kozienice) weeping that her husband despises her, and he turns her cry into a prayer for Israel.

stories.start_quote: ובספר בית נפתלי פ׳ דברים שמביא
stories.end_quote: צור ישראל קומה בעזרת ישראל עכד״ק
stories.summary_en: A woman complains to the Maggid that her husband now finds her repulsive though she was beautiful to him at the wedding; the Maggid provokes her outcry, then applies it as a plea to God not to reject Israel, His bride since Sinai.

quotes: שבאתה לפניו אשה אחת ובכתה על בעל נעוריה
